project_info.title: Lazy home to refined fashion transformation

prompt.main_subject: An adult woman transitions from a relaxed home look to an elegant refined fashion look in a cozy bedroom.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up shots contrast the early loose home styling with the finished look: gentle camisole, delicate necklace and earrings, clear makeup, pale pink shimmer eyes, pink lip color, gentle curls, and detailed baby hair.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm yellow soft light and shadow in a light-colored bedroom; after the beat transition, the light becomes gentler and hazier. Overall tone is warm pink, low saturation, and polished.

technical_specs.motion: Relaxed hair-stroking and light smile before a silky beat-synced outfit change, then slow elegant movement.
technical_specs.format: Short fashion-transition video; duration not specified.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-high-definition refined beauty outfit-change short video with cinematic soft focus and soft light, clear skin texture, fair pinkish skin tone, clean gentle picture, and delicate details. Set the scene in a cozy bedroom with a light-colored gentle background and warm yellow soft light and shadow. At the early stage, an adult woman wears a loose soft top with a natural no-makeup sense and light makeup, loose gentle hair, a clean relaxed expression, and lazy movements. She looks down, smiles lightly, and gently strokes her hair. Complete a silky outfit change with the beat of the music, using a natural soft transition as the light becomes more gentle and hazy. After the change, she has an exquisite refined fashion style with clear makeup, pale pink fine-shimmer eye makeup, moist tender pink lip color, fair skin, gentle curly hairstyle, and exquisite baby hair. She wears a slim gentle small camisole with a delicate necklace and earrings. Keep posture elegant and relaxed, eyes clean with a hint of charm, movements gentle and slow, stable close-up camera movement, warm pink low-saturation color, natural smooth dynamics, no collapse, no distortion, and high-definition image quality.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, text, logo, camera shake, flicker, unstable outfit transition, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose

assets.name: home-to-fashion transformation reference
assets.usage: Optional reference for bedroom palette, two-stage styling, makeup, hair, and accessories.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The reference is optional. Preserve the adult woman, cozy bedroom, loose home look, beat-synced transition, refined final makeup, hairstyle, camisole, necklace, earrings, and warm-pink atmosphere. Wardrobe may be replaced only when explicitly requested and must remain non-explicit.

omni_video_prompt.scene_description: An adult woman moves from a relaxed bedroom home look into a refined warm-pink fashion look through a silky beat-synced transition.
omni_video_prompt.style: Soft romantic high-definition fashion transformation with cinematic haze.
omni_video_prompt.camera_direction: Stable gentle close-up movement emphasizing the before-and-after styling contrast.
omni_video_prompt.lighting: Warm yellow soft light shifting to gentler hazy light; low-saturation warm pink grade.
omni_video_prompt.voice: None; no dialogue or voice-over supplied.

element.subject: Adult woman with loose home styling, then clear makeup, pink shimmer eye makeup, pink lip color, gentle curls, camisole, necklace, and earrings.

omni_video_prompt.ending: Hold the finished refined fashion portrait; no separate ending supplied.

changes: Removed lust-focused wording and reframed the final look as refined fashion while retaining the outfit-change concept and supported styling details.
